description: Case 1: Unprotected 404 attack with vfs_cache_pressure=0 - 4500 negative dentries exhaust free RAM and trigger OOM killer
Case 2: Optimal Bloom filter VFS guard - 4500 missing requests blocked at user-space, zero slab leakage and 0.5us latency
Case 3: High vfs_cache_pressure shrinker contention - aggressive slab reclaim acquires locks repeatedly, inflating latency to 66us
Case 4: Normal legitimate file lookups - high dentry cache hit rate (80%) with minimal slab footprint and sub-millisecond lookups
Case 5: Severe negative dentry slab bloat - slab reaches 78MB, triggering slab exhaustion threshold
Case 6: Mixed valid/missing asset workload - Bloom guard cleanly deflects 500 missing lookups while caching 500 valid dentries
Case 7: Repeated bounded missing paths - 196 negative dentry hits demonstrate positive caching efficiency for known 404s
Case 8: Extreme 10,000 vulnerability scan attack - Bloom filter deflects 100% of attack requests, keeping kernel slab at 0MB
